title.heading: Navi
title.sub: Use Chrome with just your voice
title.narrator: This is Navi, a Chrome extension that lets you use the web with just your voice. It's built for people who can't use a mouse or see the screen, and it's faster for everyone else.

steps.narrator: Turn Navi on, and just talk.
Simple commands run instantly, on your own computer, with no AI and nothing sent anywhere.
Everything you can click is given a number.
For people who can't see the screen, Navi moves through a page by its structure, and reads it aloud.
Anything else goes to an AI that clicks and types for you.

steps.say: find me a standing desk under 400 dollars and add the best one to my cart

end.heading: Navi
lines: Speech recognition runs on your computer
Off means off: the mic is closed
end.narrator: Speech recognition runs on your computer, and when Navi is off, the microphone is closed. Navi. The web, by voice.
